items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-range model that cuts API prices in half compared to its predecessor. Analysts say it sets a new standard for intelligence per dollar, especially for everyday computing tasks and AI-driven computer control. The article GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
items.summary: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. items.title: Researchers find six patterns that make AI text so exhausting to read
items.summary: A study from New York University and the University of Texas at Austin shows that frontier language models systematically overuse linguistic patterns that are hard for humans to parse. The researchers trace the problem to training on code and math, where correctness gets rewarded but clarity doesn't. Smaller models, by contrast, write more like humans. items.title: Reddit's r/opensource bans all AI-related projects, sparking backlash and a rival subreddit
items.summary: The Reddit forum r/opensource has banned all posts about AI projects, whether built with AI, AI-powered, or designed for AI. Projects must also be at least a year old and have multiple contributors, and non-English posts are excluded as well. In response, the rival forum r/TrueOpenSource has already popped up. The article Reddit's r/opensource bans all AI-related projects, sparking backlash and a rival subreddit appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. items.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027
items.summary: A new benchmark by P-Zero Research measures how well AI models design and evaluate experiments on their own. The results are improving so fast that Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now thinks self-improving AI could arrive by 2027. The article Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027 appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
items.summary: Anthropic says companies should evaluate whether they can consolidate sub-agents into a single agent that loads context on demand. In one architecture comparison, the single-agent setup ran about twice as fast. Anthropic has published a migration kit on GitHub to help teams make the transition.
